nodes.label: GitHub Pages and Render Split Architecture
nodes.norm_label: github pages and render split architecture

nodes.label: Deployment Backlog
nodes.rationale: Service creation, a pre-event end-to-end test, and event-day warmup remain incomplete deployment tasks.

nodes.label: Same-Origin SocketClient Connection
nodes.rationale: io({ transports: ['websocket'] }) without a URL connects to the current page origin, which matches the unified Render service.

nodes.label: Single-Origin Deployment
nodes.rationale: A single origin lets the existing client connect without a hard-coded backend URL and avoids GitHub Pages subpath handling.

nodes.label: Unified Render Full-Stack Architecture
nodes.rationale: Hosting the static client and Express/Socket.IO server in one same-origin Render service preserves the existing architecture and avoids code changes.

nodes.label: Root Vite Base Path
nodes.rationale: Deployment at the Render domain root means Vite does not need a GitHub Pages-style repository subpath base.

nodes.label: Repository Verification Workflow
nodes.rationale: Verification steps are run in a prescribed order and reported individually before declaring a change complete.

nodes.label: Decoupled Boost and Ghost RNG
nodes.rationale: Separate injected random functions prevent boost randomness from affecting ghost randomness and allow independent tests.

nodes.label: Authoritative Ghost and Client Replica Boundary
nodes.norm_label: authoritative ghost and client replica boundary
nodes.rationale: GhostAI performs authoritative random state progression; GhostReplicaAI is presentation-only and must never judge gameplay.

nodes.label: Single Global Tick Loop
nodes.rationale: One 100 ms interval advances every room instead of giving each room its own timer.

nodes.label: Injected Game Time
nodes.rationale: GameRoom receives now from outside rather than calling Date.now(), making time-based behavior testable.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Judging
nodes.rationale: All game judging remains on the server while clients send intent, preserving authoritative and testable outcomes.

nodes.label: Game State Machine
nodes.rationale: The room transitions through WAITING, PLAYING, GAME_OVER, and optionally PAUSED, with timed fields shifted on resume.

nodes.label: Build Client Before Static Serving
nodes.rationale: The server serves client/dist directly, so the client must be built before the server can serve a working application.

nodes.label: Waiting-Only Settings Updates
nodes.rationale: Settings changes are rejected during play to avoid inconsistent per-player state, and submitted settings are normalized.

nodes.label: Persistent Player and Host Reconnection
nodes.rationale: Persistent playerId and hostId in localStorage survive Socket.IO socket.id changes and permit reconnection within the grace period.
